## About

As an experienced statistician, I've honed my skills in higher education, contributing to research and analytical initiatives. I apply advanced spatial and survival statistical methods to public health challenges, with a focus on HIV care outcomes across Alabama and the Deep South.

I currently serve as Clinical Database Manager II with the UAB Center for AIDS Research (CFAR), and I am completing my Doctor of Public Health (DrPH) in Biostatistics at UAB, with a dissertation on shared frailty models for spatial data applied to time to HIV viral suppression. My work sits at the intersection of survival analysis, spatial and Bayesian statistical methods, and structural determinants of HIV care outcomes — including a [study on historical redlining and delays in HIV treatment](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2024.5003) that has been covered in the [national press](press.qmd).
:::

## Research interests

Time-to-event / survival analysis · Frailty models · Spatial and Bayesian spatial modeling · HIV/AIDS and infectious disease · Substance Abuse · Environmental health · Health Policy · Structural determinants of health

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tsparticles/slim@4/tsparticles.slim.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var container = document.getElementById("about-particles");
  if (!container) return;

  // Respect the visitor's OS/browser motion preference — if they've
  // asked for reduced motion, skip the animated layer entirely and
  // leave just the static watermark image already behind the text.
  if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
    return;
  }
  if (typeof tsParticles === "undefined" || typeof loadSlim === "undefined") return;

  var engineReady = loadSlim(tsParticles);

  // A soft, low-opacity "constellation" that drifts on its own and
  // gently links up wherever the cursor hovers over the card — kept
  // subtle since it sits directly behind the About paragraph text.
  // Colors swap to the site's dark-mode accent when the visitor
  // toggles dark mode (see the toggle listener below).
  function particleColors() {
    var dark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
    // Light mode's card background is a very pale off-white/cream (the
    // topo watermark image), so the maroon site accent — already dark
    // and saturated enough to read clearly on its own as link text —
    // is used here too, at a bit more opacity than the dark-mode dot
    // color needs, since the dark-mode pink already has plenty of
    // contrast against the near-black card at a lower opacity.
    return dark
      ? { dot: "#d9808c", link: "#a19c93", dotOpacity: 0.35, linkOpacity: 0.25 }
      : { dot: "#7a1f2b", link: "#7a1f2b", dotOpacity: 0.5, linkOpacity: 0.2 };
  }

  function buildOptions() {
    var c = particleColors();
    return {
      fullScreen: { enable: false },
      background: { color: "transparent" },
      fpsLimit: 60,
      pauseOnBlur: true,
      pauseOnOutsideViewport: true,
      particles: {
        number: { value: 40 },
        color: { value: c.dot },
        opacity: { value: c.dotOpacity },
        size: { value: { min: 1, max: 3 } },
        links: {
          enable: true,
          color: c.link,
          distance: 130,
          opacity: c.linkOpacity,
          width: 1
        },
        move: {
          enable: true,
          speed: 0.6,
          outModes: { default: "bounce" }
        }
      },
      interactivity: {
        events: {
          onHover: { enable: true, mode: "grab" },
          onClick: { enable: false },
          resize: true
        },
        modes: {
          grab: { distance: 140, links: { opacity: 0.45 } }
        }
      },
      responsive: [
        { maxWidth: 600, options: { particles: { number: { value: 18 } } } }
      ]
    };
  }

  function initParticles() {
    engineReady.then(function () {
      // Loading again with the same id replaces the previous instance
      // in place, so this doubles as the dark-mode re-color step below.
      tsParticles.load({ id: "about-particles", options: buildOptions() });
    });
  }

  initParticles();

  var toggle = document.querySelector(".quarto-color-scheme-toggle");
  if (toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
      // Small delay so document.body already has the new
      // .quarto-dark/.quarto-light class by the time we re-read it.
      setTimeout(initParticles, 60);
    });
  }
})();
</script>
